Running Azure Functions in Docker

What changes when a Function App leaves the consumption plan and moves into a container.

Most teams meet Azure Functions on the consumption plan. Moving them into a container is not hard, but the documentation skips a few steps. Use func init --docker to start.

The Dockerfile

Start from the official base image:

FROM mcr.microsoft.com/azure-functions/dotnet-isolated:8.0
ENV AzureWebJobsScriptRoot=/home/site/wwwroot
COPY --from=build /out /home/site/wwwroot

Things to check

  • Storage connection strings
  • The FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME setting
  1. Build the image
  2. Run it locally
If it works on the consumption plan, it will work in a container. Mostly.
